## Common Questions
- How to get bail in Pakistan: Bail is pre-arrest (Section 498 CrPC) or post-arrest (Section 497 CrPC). For bailable offences bail is a right; for non-bailable offences an advocate files a bail application before the Sessions Court or High Court.
- How to file for Khula in Pakistan: A wife files a suit for dissolution of marriage in Family Court under the Dissolution of Muslim Marriages Act, 1939; the process typically takes 3–6 months.
- Lawyer fees: Consultation starts from PKR 5,000; case fees vary by complexity. Contact +92 300 6829799 for an assessment.
